regions.name: Periyar
regions.quote: It is mainly distributed in the Chalakkudy, Pamba, Periyar, Kabani, Bharathapuzha, Vamanapuram and Muvattupuzha rivers, Lake Vembanad and the kole wetlands of Thrissur, Kallar stream and Neyyar wildlife sanctuary of south Kerala.
